svg.text: A 3D half pipe (length compressed 40x; real pipe is 4 m long, 25 mm across)
flat underside = symmetry plane z = 0 (other half is the mirror image)
B Cross-section mesh: 888 cells (O-grid, 6 cells per 45 deg sector)
(y axis to the right, z axis up; heated sectors q1..q4 on the outer copper surface)
C Zoom on the wall at the top of the pipe (2.5 mm tall window)
D Side view, cells along the pipe: 506 (20 mm unheated, 5 mm heated)
